title: Weekend plans
instructions: Jack ve Lily hafta sonu için plan yapıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; önerilen ve seçilen planı ayırt et.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Lily, what do you want to do this weekend?

script.speaker: lily
script.text: I don't know. What about the beach on Saturday?

script.speaker: jack
script.text: The weather isn't good on Saturday. It's going to rain.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: Oh no. What about the cinema, then? There is a new comedy.

script.speaker: jack
script.text: I saw it last week. It's not very funny.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: OK. Do you want to visit the science museum?

script.speaker: jack
script.text: Yes, good idea! It's open on Saturday from nine to five.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: Great. Let's go in the morning, at ten.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: Sunday is sunny. Let's have a picnic in the park with my sister.

script.speaker: lily
script.text: And I can bring the drinks and some fruit.

questions.prompt: Why don't they go to the beach?
questions.feedback: Cumartesi yağmur yağacak (It's going to rain), bu yüzden plaja gitmiyorlar.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Jack want to see the comedy?
questions.feedback: Jack filmi geçen hafta izledi (I saw it last week) ve pek komik bulmadı.

questions.prompt: What time are they going to the museum?
questions.feedback: Müzeye saat onda (at ten) gidecekler. Dokuz ve beş, müzenin açılış-kapanış saatleri.
questions.evidence: Let's go in the morning, at ten.

questions.prompt: What is Jack going to bring to the picnic?
questions.feedback: Jack sandviç (sandwiches) yapacak. İçecek ve meyveyi Lily getirecek.
